def get(  # type: ignore[override]
        self,
        name: str,
        default: str | None = None,
        domain: str | None = None,
        path: str | None = None,
    ) -> str | None:

for cookie in jar:
                self._put(
                    _Cookie(
                        cookie.name,
                        cookie.value or "",
                        cookie.domain.lstrip(".").lower(),
                        cookie.path or "/",
                        bool(cookie.domain) and not cookie.domain_specified,
                        cookie.secure,
                        cookie.expires,
                    )
                )

for jar_cookie in jar:
                self._put(
                    _Cookie(
                        jar_cookie.name,
                        jar_cookie.value or "",
                        jar_cookie.domain.lstrip(".").lower(),
                        jar_cookie.path or "/",
                        bool(jar_cookie.domain) and not jar_cookie.domain_specified,
                        jar_cookie.secure,
                        jar_cookie.expires,
                    )
                )
